console.claimedBody: This organisation now maintains its own information. Admin edits are read-only; the organisation's members update it from their workspace.
console.readOnlyTitle: You can read this record, not change it
console.readOnlyBody: Ask a platform operator, or a member of this organisation, to make the change.
table.name: Name
field.areaHint: Used by the simulator location question
precision.hint: What must never be published, and at what precision?
spec.hint: Marking a primary is optional: organisations providing several services equally mark none.
lang.hint: Languages in which people are actually served.
contact.label: Label (français)
empty.activities: No activities yet. Create the first one from today’s runbook.
org.statusHint: “Verified” asserts a real identity check happened.
org.listSub: Every organisation in the directory. The platform maintains a record until the organisation claims it — after that its own members keep it up to date.
org.newSub: Create the record so activities and places can point at it. The organisation can claim it later.
org.createDenied: Creating a directory record is a platform-operator task. Ask an operator, or switch to a role that can verify organisations.
org.claimFlowBody: Invite someone from the organisation as an administrator. The first time they sign in, the record becomes theirs and the platform keeps read-only access.
org.ownEditBody: Changes are published under your organisation's name. The platform can no longer edit this record.
org.archiveHint: Archiving removes the organisation from the public directory and from new activities. Its record and history are kept.
org.archiveConfirmBody: It will immediately disappear from the public directory and cannot be linked to new activities. Its record and history will be kept.
org.restoreHint: Restoring brings the organisation back as a draft. Verify it again before it appears publicly.
org.releaseClaimHint: Support only. Hands write access back to the platform — say why (recorded in the audit log).
org.noMembership: You do not belong to any organisation yet. Ask an administrator to invite you.
org.directoryPlatformOnlyTitle: The full directory is a platform view
org.directoryPlatformOnlyBody: Listing every organisation is a platform-operator task. Here you keep your own record up to date.
record.hint: Identifiers and dates kept by the platform.
members.hint: Every member with the roles granted to them. Roles decide what someone may do — a title does not.
members.hidden: Only this organisation's administrators can see its members.
members.empty: No member has been invited yet.
invite.none: No invitation is waiting to be accepted.
invite.title: Title / role
invite.titleHint: The function they hold in the association
invite.hint: The invitation expires in 14 days and grants nothing until it is accepted. organization_admin hands this record to the organisation: the platform keeps read-only access from then on.
service.sourceHint: Where does this information come from?
activity.title: Recent activity
settings.title: Settings
settings.sub: Platform catalogues — cities and languages are data, not code.
activities.title: Activities
activities.sub: Manage each scheduled activity, its reusable services, recurring hours, and activity team.
activity.create.title: New activity
activity.create.hint: Create the source content, practical access details, schedule, and ownership in one draft.
activity.create.error: The activity could not be created. Check the required fields and schedule, then try again.
activity.create.contentHint: Choose the language used for the original information.
activity.create.sourceLanguageHint: This is the authoritative text translators compare against.
activity.create.scheduleHint: Use one-off for a single dated occurrence, or recurring for regular weekly hours.
activity.create.fixedTimeHint: The activity is expected to follow this exact window.
activity.create.flexibleTimeHint: The activity happens within this approximate window; confirm before travelling.
activity.create.exceptionHint: Record a closure, cancellation, exceptional opening, or uncertainty without changing the normal schedule.
activity.create.locationHint: Reuse a place, create one with address suggestions, or mark the activity as mobile.
activity.create.mobileHint: No exact place will be attached. Add a safe contact if visitors need access instructions.
activity.create.addressHelp: Select a verified French address suggestion for exact coordinates.
activity.create.addressEmpty: No address found. Try a broader search.
activity.create.addressError: Address suggestions are unavailable. You can continue with a non-exact location.
activity.platformOwnerHint: InfoKit answers for this activity itself, so no association is named as its creator or provider.
activity.create.teamHint: The existing organisation/city team is reused; otherwise this name creates it.
activity.create.noContacts: No public contacts for this organisation
activity.create.contactsHint: Only organisation-approved public contact methods can be attached.
activity.create.contactRequired: Choose at least one contact because the exact location is withheld.
activity.create.contactYouHint: saved as a public contact of this organisation
activity.create.image.rights: I confirm the organisation may publish this image.
activity.create.image.error: The image could not be uploaded.
activity.create.image.constraints: JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF, up to 1 MB. Large images are reduced automatically.
activity.cityTeamHint: The area team responsible for all of this organisation’s activities in this city. It follows the activity’s city and is not assigned here.
activity.noServices: No reusable services assigned yet. Add them from the runbook.
activity.scheduleHint: Add a one-off date and time, or recurring weekly hours. Overlapping times are not allowed.
activity.scheduleRemoveDescription: {schedule} will no longer create activity occurrences.
activity.scheduleInvalidRange: The end time must be later than the start time.
activity.scheduleOverlap: These hours overlap with an existing range for this day.
activity.scheduleInvalid: Enter a valid schedule type, date or weekday, start time, and end time.
activity.membersHint: The people assigned specifically to this activity. Choose from the city team, or enter a new email to add someone to both.
serviceManager.assignmentSaveError: Services could not be saved. Please try again.
serviceManager.catalogueHint: Create and maintain this organisation’s service options here. Platform services remain read-only.
serviceManager.catalogueEmpty: This organisation has not created a reusable service yet.
serviceManager.createHint: The service will be saved to the organisation catalogue and assigned to this activity.
serviceManager.editHint: Changes apply anywhere this reusable service is assigned.
serviceManager.archiveHint: It will be removed from every activity. You can restore it later.
serviceManager.sourceHint: Where this service information came from.
serviceManager.iconHint: Use a supported catalogue icon such as utensils, droplet, shower, heart, scale, phone, home, or sparkles.
member.emailHint: Search this city team. A new email will be invited to the city team and assigned to this activity.
member.searchPlaceholder: Search the city team or enter an email
member.noMatch: No city-team member found — enter a valid email to invite them
member.publicHint: Public mode requires both approved public fields. The member email, account, and private profile are never exposed.
member.workspaceHint: Association-only keeps the member, email, expertise, and assignment inside this organisation workspace.
member.inviteNote: Nobody in the association carries this address yet. Say who they are and they join the city team of this activity; if they have no account, an invitation will be sent.
member.title: Title / role
member.titleHint: The function they hold in the association — “Maraude coordination”, not a form of address.
member.phoneHint: The number the team actually dials — a mobile, a duty phone, or an extension.
member.languagesSpokenHint: Any language the person can welcome people in, including ones the site is not published in.
member.skillsHint: Picked from the shared list so a mission can check them automatically. Missing one? Add it under Skills & courses.
member.skillsEmpty: Nothing matches — add it under Skills & courses first.
member.saveError: The member could not be assigned. Check the form and try again.
member.removeError: The member could not be removed. Try again.
member.empty: No one is assigned to this activity team yet.
team.title: City teams
team.sub: Everybody on an association’s books, city team by city team. A member does not need a team: drag a card onto one when there is one to join.
team.none: Nothing to show yet. Create a city team, or add a member — they can wait without one until a team exists.
team.memberRemoved: Removed from the city team and its activity teams.
team.unassignedHint: On the association’s books, waiting for a team.
team.dragHint: Drag a card between columns, or use the row menu.
team.empty: Nobody on this city team yet — drag a card in, or add somebody.
team.addMemberHint: Name, role, phone and email are all required. The city team is not: leave it empty and the person waits under “No city team yet”.
team.addMemberNote: If no account exists for this address, an email invitation is sent right away.
team.invited: Member added to the city team.
team.inviteError: The invitation could not be sent. Check the email address and try again.
team.createHint: A city team manages one organisation’s work in one city. Activity teams are selected from its members.
team.nameHint: Defaults to a city-based name if left empty.
team.createError: The city team could not be created. This organisation may already have one in that city.
team.disabled: Member management is not enabled on this instance.
team.statUnassignedHint: Drag them onto a city team.
rowAction.unpublishBody: The {language} page comes off the public site. The activity and its text stay here, and you can publish the language again at any time.
rowAction.deleteBody: It leaves the workspace. Nothing of it is published, so the public sees no change, and its history stays on record.
publication.heading: Publication
publication.hint: Draft is the safe default. A colleague’s read is optional; the platform’s check is required before anything goes public.
publication.team: Send to a colleague to read
publication.platform: Send to the platform to verify
publication.dateHint: The date is entered in your local time and displayed in Europe/Paris time.
detail.contentHint: Edit the activity name and description per language. The source language can publish first.
freshness.warning: This activity is due for a freshness check.
freshness.confirmed: Marked as checked. It is due again in 30 days.
media.title: Photo
media.hint: Shown on the public activity card. Confirm you have the rights to use it.
media.rights: I confirm we have the rights to publish this file.
media.downloadsHint: Flyers or documents visitors can download.
media.constraints: JPG, PNG, WebP or AVIF, up to 1 MB. Large images are reduced automatically.
detail.translationsHint: Send each language to a translator and review what comes back.
editor.tagsHint: Choose up to 3 approved public tags. Tags classify content; they do not grant access.
editor.tagsEmpty: No approved public tags are available yet.
translation.orgHint: The profile narrative is written in one language; the others are translations of it.
translation.sourceHint: Changing the source language re-seals the version translators receive.
translation.needsSource: Write the narrative in the source language first.
translation.requestHint: The translator receives a secure, expiring link and only the organisation narrative.
translation.name: Translator name
translation.reviewHint: Accepting publishes this text on the organisation record. Rejecting keeps it offline.
narrative.editHint: Click any paragraph to edit it. Escape undoes your change.
narrative.saveError: The narrative could not be saved. A public purpose is required.
steward.title: Who to ask about this record
steward.hint: Visible to people with an account, never on a public page. Anyone in the network who spots an error contacts this person instead of guessing.
steward.author: Entered this record
steward.membersHint: Pick someone to fill in their name and contact details, or write anybody else in below.
steward.name: Person or role
steward.nameHint: A name or a role — “day centre coordinator” is enough.
steward.phoneHint: A service number, not a private mobile.
steward.privacy: One of the two is enough. This contact is never published: only signed-in editors and partner organisations can see it.
steward.empty: No contact recorded — add one so errors can be reported.
steward.saveError: The contact could not be saved. Check the phone number and email, then try again.
address.help: Choose a suggestion to fill the postal code and coordinates. You can still enter an address manually.
address.empty: No matching address found. You can keep the address you entered.
address.error: Address suggestions are temporarily unavailable. You can continue manually.
transit.title: Getting here
transit.hint: The buses, trams and trains that reach this place, and the stop to get off at. Published, in every language: the line number stays as it is printed, the mode is translated.
transit.empty: Nothing recorded — a reader is left to guess whether they can get here without a car.
transit.detailHint: A line, a stop, or both. Write them the way the network prints them, so someone can read the name out to a driver.
transit.saveError: The transport could not be saved. Check the walking time is a number of minutes, then try again.
activity.create.scopeCityHint: Almost every activity happens in one city.
activity.create.scopeGlobalHint: Rare: a nationwide helpline or an online service that belongs to no city.
activity.create.globalLocationHint: A global activity has no address and no city team. Add a safe contact so people know how to reach it.
activity.create.image.altHint: Describe what the photograph shows, for people who cannot see it. Translate it in the Translations panel above.
staff.title: Platform staff
staff.sub: Who works on InfoKit, and by what grant.
staff.separationTitle: Administering and publishing are two roles
staff.separationBody: The founding account administers the platform and carries no content permission: publishing is somebody else's job, so the audit trail can say who published what. Invite the person who will manage content here.
staff.listHint: Roles held globally. An association's own roles are on its record.
staff.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, email, role or access
staff.changeRoleBody: Choose the platform role {name} should hold. Their current platform roles will be replaced.
staff.revokeAccessBody: {name} will be signed out on every device. Their role remains active, so they can sign in again.
staff.disableAccessBody: {name} will be signed out and their platform roles will stop granting access. They remain in this list so access can be restored.
staff.enableAccessBody: {name}'s retained platform roles will grant access again.
staff.removeStaffBody: {name} will be signed out and all of their platform roles will be removed. This does not remove any separate association membership.
staff.inviteBody: Assign one platform role. An existing account receives it immediately; otherwise an invitation is sent.
staff.emailHint: An existing account is granted the role at once; otherwise an invitation is sent.
staff.pendingHint: Nothing is granted before acceptance, so withdrawing the invitation is the whole undo.
staff.actionError: The platform staff change could not be completed. Try again.
serviceManager.archiveSuccess: Reusable service archived and removed from its activities.
org.representativeSub: Name the person who will maintain this record and they are invited as soon as it is created. Leave it empty to create a directory entry the platform maintains for now.
org.representativeEmailHint: Fill this in to invite; leave it empty and the rest of this section is ignored.
org.createInvitedSuccess: Organisation created and the invitation sent.
org.createGrantedSuccess: Organisation created. The representative already had an account, so access was granted straight away — no email was sent.
org.createdNextStep: Invitations, roles and the public profile are managed from this page.
org.createError: The organisation could not be created. Check the required fields and try again.
org.claimReleased: Organisation claim released to platform support.
roles.title: Roles & access
roles.sub: The roles available in {organization} and the access each one grants.
roles.noMembership: You do not have an active organisation workspace.
roles.hintManage: You decide who holds which role in this organisation.
roles.hintReadOnly: The roles in this organisation and what each one allows.
roleDescription.coordinator: Organises teams, internal planning, and events shared with other organisations.
roleDescription.document_signatory: Views and signs only the documents assigned to them.
roleDescription.inventory_finance: Reads stock records, including restricted cost and value figures.
roleDescription.inventory_manager: Looks after storage locations, item catalogues, stock movements, and their history.
roleDescription.organization_admin: Looks after the organisation's profile, its members, and who holds which role.
roleDescription.organization_author: Writes and translates the organisation's articles, without publishing them.
roleDescription.organization_editor: Keeps the organisation's public information and articles up to date.
roleDescription.organization_publisher: Writes articles and decides when they go live.
roleDescription.organization_translator: Completes the translation work assigned to them.
roleDescription.organization_verifier: Checks that published information is still accurate and marks it as verified.
roleDescription.team_lead: Manages teams and internal planning for the organisation.
roleDescription.translation_reviewer: Reviews translations others have submitted, and accepts or returns them.
permission.content.activity.manage: Add and update places, services, activities, timetables, and public events.
permission.content.activity.verify: Confirm that activity, service, timetable, and event details are still correct.
permission.content.article.publish: Publish, unpublish, and archive the organisation's articles.
permission.content.article.review: Review and approve article translations that have been submitted.
permission.content.article.write: Write, edit, and translate the organisation's articles.
permission.content.translation.review: Accept, reject, or ask for changes to a translator's work.
permission.content.translation.submit: Take on assigned translation work and submit it for review.
permission.content.translation.verify: Confirm that a machine translation has been checked by someone who reads the language.
permission.coordination.event.manage: Create and run coordination events shared with other organisations.
permission.courses.manage: Maintain the training catalogue and decide how widely each course is shared.
permission.courses.qualification.verify: Accept or refuse a course a member says they have completed.
permission.documents.sign_assigned: View and sign documents assigned to you.
permission.inventory.audit.read: Read the history of stock movements and reconciliations.
permission.inventory.catalog.manage: Maintain item categories, items, variants, units, and how they are tracked.
permission.inventory.financial.read: Read restricted cost and replacement-value figures.
permission.inventory.locations.manage: Create and maintain storage locations and how they operate.
permission.inventory.move: Record stock coming in, going out, being moved, reserved, or distributed.
permission.inventory.read: Read stock locations, catalogues, balances, alerts, and movements.
permission.members.manage: Invite, activate, update, deactivate, and remove members.
permission.members.read: See the member list and membership details.
permission.organization.profile.manage: Maintain the organisation's public profile and contact details.
permission.planning.manage: Manage availability, shifts, missions, meetings, and internal planning.
permission.roles.manage: Give and take away roles within the organisation.
permission.teams.manage: Manage teams, who is in them, and their assignments.
permission.translator.directory.manage: Invite external translators and manage their directory entries.
members.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, title or contact
invite.dialogHint: They receive a link and appear on the roster straight away, with no access until they accept.
roles.matrix.hint: Read across a row to see which roles may do that thing, or down a column to see everything one role may do.
